newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan steel shares up on steel rod price hikes.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan steel shares up on steel rod price hikes.

text.p: Taiwan's steel shares rose at mid-morning on Tuesday on price hikes of domestic steel rods, brokers said.
After 90 minutes, Kuei Hung Industry was up 80 cents or 3.58 percent to T$23.20, and Feng Hsin Iron had gained 60 cents or 1.88 percent to T$32.50.
"These steel rod makers should benefit from the price hikes, but it should be only a short-lived gain," said Henry Chen, an analyst at Yuan Ta Securities.
Chen said that because the property market is widely expected to recover soon, steel makers should anticipate a rise in construction projects.
